method: Retain v5 stabilization and all original gates; append two directions of 5- and 8-segment arcs around the predicted failed-vehicle braking endpoint at effective clearance plus 1.4 m.
known_probe: The bottleneck seed 13303 single-condition v6 probe succeeded after observing the valid v5 refusal; it is exploratory and is not reused as formal development evidence.
preserve: Original geometry, seeds, expected labels, condition order, all speed/acceleration, clearance, route-length, rollout, RA, and v5 stabilization settings.
sequence: New-root full paired calibration from first case; only complete calibration GO permits the untouched qualification geometry and seeds; only qualification GO permits corrected sealed and dependent comparison.
stop_rule: After each complete paired case, stop dependent conditions on a valid admission or hold failure; retain all valid baseline and negative outcomes. Only infrastructure-invalid attempts may be retried at the same seed and condition. Never relabel, loosen a bound, or rerun a valid failure until it passes.
